name: Silvermist
body:
Aura faint conjuration; CL 1st; Price +1 bonus; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

Silvermist armor is etched and filigreed and stitched in patterns of clouds and swirls. This armor ability can be added to any light armor as well as any mithral armor. Three times per day as a standard action the wearer of this armor can cause all squares within 20 ft. of themselves to fill with mist which provides concealment as the spell obscuring mist but does not interfere with the wearer’s own vision. This mist lasts for 1 minute.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor; Spells obscuring mist
